author: DOC-029 source-review author agent (entities)
changeRangeInspected: git diff 8539f4cc..3fa407e3 -- apps packages (entity, counterparty, Home obligation, access, chart, share capital files); the article history also shows commit 41390ca0 removed Contributor wording after the recorded evidence hashes.
classification: Behavior, permission, and label changes. Not copy-only: V-C31, V-C32, V-C52, and V-C53 need a fresh independent walkthrough against the corrected content.

corrections.before: A Confidential Entity requires an explicit Grant unless you are an Administrator.
corrections.after: A Confidential Entity requires a Grant for every person, including Administrators.
corrections.basis: entityReachScope gives administrators the same grant-or-open rule as Legal Team Members (commit cb453470; DD-014 and ENT-004 amendments of 10 September 2026).

corrections.location: Register and update an Entity, step 3
corrections.basis: entities.register and entities.form.title are now 'Add entity' (commit 68624ded). The submit button is still 'Register'.

corrections.location: Register and update an Entity, step 2
corrections.before: Only the list filters are named for checking existing records.
corrections.after: Also names the 'Search entities by name' box, which filters by legal name.
corrections.basis: entities.tsx search input (aria-label entities.search) and the API q parameter (ilike on legal_name).

corrections.location: Register and update an Entity, step 5
corrections.before: No statement about access for the person who registers the Entity.
corrections.after: You receive a Grant for the Entity that you add.
corrections.basis: POST /entities inserts an entity_grants row for the creator and records entity_grant.added.

confirmed: Entities first view is Calendar; List and Chart are the other views.
List filters Type, Status, Jurisdiction, Majority owner, Clear all, and Show archived.

Add entity dialog fields: Legal name, Entity type, Status (default Active), Formation jurisdiction, Formed on, Registration no., Tax ID, Registered agent, Registered address; submit Register; blank name refused with 'Name the entity — its registered legal name.'
Legal names are not unique; the create route has no uniqueness check.
Entity Status values Active, Dormant, Dissolved, Divested are separate from archive.
Entities loader redirects non-Member+ users; the API is Member+ only. Contributor is a removed role (DD-023).
Contract Overview labels: Our entity (select), Counterparties, Create "name", Primary, Make primary, 'Take {name} off the contract'.
Picker hides create when a case-insensitive exact name exists and excludes Counterparties already on the Contract; the API reuses a live same-name Counterparty.
Removing the primary passes the mark to the next-joined party; frozen (archived) Contracts hide party controls.

corrections.after: Card 'Directors & Officers', button 'Add director or officer', field 'Director or officer name'.
corrections.basis: officers-card.tsx label change (commit 9ec5e8a2 series). The heading and the Officer domain term are kept.

confirmed: Officers and Registrations cards are on Overview; Holdings are on the Ownership tab with Add Holding, Relationship (Owns this Entity / This Entity owns), Entity, Ownership percent, Add, Owners, Owned Entities, Remove {name}.
Officer fields Role, Appointed on, Resigned on, Linked user, Show former, Remove {officer}.
Registration fields Jurisdiction, Registration number, Registered agent, Status Active/Lapsed/Withdrawn, 'Remove {jurisdiction} registration'.
Ownership total over 100 shows 'Ownership totals {total}% for {name}.' and saves.
Record routes, holding routes, and obligation routes are unchanged between 8539f4cc and 3fa407e3.
Archive/Restore buttons on the record, 'This entity is archived. Restore it to edit.', Show archived in the List, row Restore.
No seeded Entity folders (ENT-005).

corrections.before: Administrators also see unassigned Obligations and those whose named assignee cannot reach the Entity.
corrections.after: On the Entities they can reach, Administrators also see those Obligations.
corrections.basis: Home section composes entityReachScope; administrators no longer reach Confidential Entities without a Grant.

corrections.location: Recover from a mistake or refusal
corrections.before: ask an Administrator to review access
corrections.after: ask a person with a Grant on that Entity to review access
corrections.basis: canManageEntityAccess: only grantees manage a Confidential Entity; an Administrator without a Grant cannot.

confirmed: Obligations tab labels: Add obligation, Label, Due date, Repeat every (months), Registration, Assignee, Matter, Note, 'Mark {label} filed', Filed on, Mark filed, 'Delete {label}', Filed.
Assignee must be a live Legal Team Member or Administrator; Matter must be live and reachable; Registration must belong to the Entity.
Calendar: Due-date list, Month, Entity, Assignee, From, To, Include completed, Apply, Previous month, Next month, Today, Clear all; overdue rows first.
Recurring filing advances until the next due date is after the filing date (fileRecurring message and obligation-routes).
Morning round reminders use entityReachedBy, which already follows the grant rule.
obligation-routes.ts is unchanged since the earlier walkthrough build.
limitations: Home fallback bug (reported in productBugs): assigneeCanReachEntity still treats every Administrator assignee as reaching the Entity, so an Obligation on a Confidential Entity assigned to an Administrator without a Grant is not surfaced to granted Administrators. The article describes the intended rule.

corrections.before: Only an Administrator changes the Confidential flag or Grants.
corrections.after: A Confidential Entity needs a Grant for every person, including Administrators. Grant holders change the flag and Grants; an Administrator also can while the Entity is not Confidential. The person who adds an Entity receives a Grant.
corrections.basis: canManageEntityAccess, entityReachScope, creator grant in POST /entities; DD-014/ENT-004 amendments.

corrections.before: Field 'Par value (minor units)', whole numbers only, no currency selector.
corrections.after: Choose Currency first; Par value is unavailable until then and takes an amount with up to the currency's decimal places; changing Currency keeps the amount.
corrections.basis: share-capital-card.tsx (Currency select, toMinorUnits, invalidAmount message); API refuses a par value without a currency.

corrections.before: Secondary connections; an Entity with no recorded owner can appear separately.
corrections.after: Primary Holding is a solid line, others dashed; an Entity with no Holdings appears in a separate row.
corrections.basis: entities.chart.description and layoutEntityChart (unconnected nodes in the final row; an unowned owner is a root, not separate).

corrections.before: Open a named Entity from its chart link; unreachable nodes are 'Restricted Entity'.
corrections.after: Single click or Space highlights the ownership chain (Clear highlight / Escape); double-click or Enter opens; unreachable nodes show 'Confidential Entity'.

corrections.before: Primary owner is chosen from the recorded percentages.
corrections.after: Primary owner is the owner with the highest recorded percentage.
corrections.basis: holding-routes.ts chart projection sorts owners by percent, then name.

corrections.location: Grant access to a Confidential Entity
corrections.before: Administrator turns on 'Confidential — restrict to the grant list' first, Administrators keep access, grants only to Legal Team Members, Legal Team Members cannot manage access.
corrections.after: A grantee (or an Administrator on an open Entity) opens Manage access, grants live Legal Team Members or Administrators in Person, includes themselves, then turns on 'Confidential — restrict to the access list'; enabling with no live grantee and removing the last live grantee are refused; grant holders manage access; an Administrator without a Grant cannot open or self-grant.
corrections.basis: grant-routes.ts (requireAccessManager, candidates include administrators, 409 on last grantee), routes.ts PATCH (409 'Grant at least one person access before making this entity confidential.'), confidential-toggle.tsx label, entity-grants-dialog.tsx.

corrections.after: Adds that the ownership chart shows such an Entity as Confidential Entity.
corrections.basis: ownership-card.tsx and contract-record.tsx still use 'Restricted Entity'; entity-chart.tsx uses 'Confidential Entity'.

confirmed: Share capital labels Authorized shares, Issued shares, Par value, Currency; whole numbers of zero or more for share counts; Enter/blur saves; Escape reverts.
Chart keyboard: arrows pan, plus/minus zoom, zero fits; Fit to window; drag and wheel.

Contracts tab lists Contracts by Our entity; Matters tab by saved Entity-valued Field values (matterNamesEntity checks all entity Fields, so a detached Field value keeps the link); both compose record reach.
Issue #774 (Matter Overview Entity choices) is fixed and closed; the article makes no claim that depends on it.
Business Users reach no Entity (entityReachScope returns false).
limitations: A par value saved before migration 0096 has no currency and shows blank until a Currency is chosen (reported in productBugs); the article does not describe this legacy case.
Chart description copy says 'Majority Holdings' although the primary owner need not hold a majority (reported in productBugs); the article describes the actual rule.
Source inspection only. No browser walkthrough was run by this author seat; the independent walkthrough is still required before verification.
